title: Vietnamese Pork Noodle Bowl
description: A flavorful and refreshing Vietnamese-inspired dish made with pork, noodles, and crunchy vegetables.

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder
ingredients.notes: Slice into thin strips before cooking

ingredients.name: Crunchy Vietnamese pickled carrots and daikon

instructions: Cook the rice noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet or wok, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced pork and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil and sauté the pickled carrots and daikon until slightly caramelized.
Add the cooked noodles, soy sauce, and cooked pork back into the skillet. Stir to combine.
Transfer the noodle mixture to a serving bowl and garnish with cilantro leaves, scallions, and crushed black pepper.
